scope: Bounded public Pan-UKB EUR source/statistic/sample audit for Tracks A and C; Track B Japanese source audit remains in tracks/B; no genotypes acquired or recomputed LD

panukb_EUR_source.ancestry: Pan-UKB EUR population defined by project ancestry/QC pipeline, not identical by assertion to every UKB European/white-British GWAS subset
panukb_EUR_source.build: GRCh37; actual Hail locus schema and native index keys
panukb_EUR_source.counted_allele: ALT dosage (alleles[1]); exact ordered native reference/alternate index key
panukb_EUR_source.statistic: signed residualized standardized-dosage Gram product; not r-squared or an LD-score table
panukb_EUR_source.public_documented_genotypes: UKB imputed version3 BGEN dosages; official UKB source background HRC+UK10K/1000Genomes imputation
panukb_EUR_source.missing_dosages: historical source writes mean_impute=True into genotype block matrix
panukb_EUR_source.documented_input_QC: INFO>0.8 and population MAC around20; historical/default/current script details differ at19 versus20 and actual executed parameter values are not release-bound
panukb_EUR_source.normalization: row-wise genotype centering and population-SD standardization before unweighted linear covariate projection; G=ZZ^T/n; no second normalization after residualization in historical or current inspected code
panukb_EUR_source.representation: upper triangle plus 10Mb pair-distance band; observed original triangle/positive diagonal tested per locus by root numeric audit
panukb_EUR_source.diagnostic_derived_correlation: R_ij=G_ij/sqrt(G_ii*G_jj), saved separately and hashed; semantic conversion, not PSD repair or scientific guarantee that R is covariance of GWAS z

historical_code_lineage.post_object_changes: adds chrX rows, min_mac19, temporary paths/checkpoint choices; Gram/residualization/10Mb/triangle core unchanged
historical_code_lineage.observed_lineage_limit: Pre-object compute script includes autosomes only, whereas actual release index includes chromosomeX. Post-object code addsX. A public commit date therefore does not prove actual run code/version/arguments; original job log/environment and release manifest remain absent.
historical_code_lineage.genotype_helper_lineage: Oct22 snapshot documents compensating transformation for underlying frequency AF-doubled/AN-halved artifact; not evidence the downloaded matrix is numerically wrong; underscores need for exact execution lineage.
historical_code_lineage.artifacts: tracks/C/sources/pan_pre_object_snapshot_*, pan_pre_object_*, pan_post_object_*, pan_ld_historical_code.diff and API history receipts

C.relationship: Same project, same ancestry framework, near-overlap source cohorts; exact participant overlap/missingness not proven; not labeled exactly matched phenotype-specific in-sample LD
C.test: SAIGE binary mixed-model score test with saddlepoint approximation
C.saige_version_metadata: SAIGE_0.36.3; exact current Hail J44 EUR pheno_data; inv_normalized=false
C.SE_semantics: Version0.36.3 source constructs SE=abs(logOR/qnorm(SPA_P/2)); numerical P agreement is arithmetic by construction, not independent Wald likelihood validation
C.exact_version_lineage_caveat: Current public Hail column container modified2024; source EUR counts agree but its metadata is not a checksum-bound original2023 per-phenotype run log
C.N_absence: GWAS per-variant N absent; variant-manifest AN/2 broader458317-458937 cohort cannot substitute; no automatic effective-N conversion
C.reference_ld_candidacy: Suitable to test as a same-project signed reference with unusually strong allele/cohort documentation; compatible RSS sampling model still not established
unresolved_gates: Exact LD execution release/code/parameters and precise sample-membership relationship
Per-variant GWAS observed sample sizes or approved likelihood sample-size derivation
Mapping SPA-calibrated beta/SE z to appropriate covariate/mixed-model genotype-score covariance; unweighted residual genotype correlation is not automatically sufficient
Complete locus coverage/missingness, boundary and matrix diagnostics as reported in separate root outputs
Investigator approval of source/statistic/reference approximation and complete future input freeze after all gates

A.gwas: GCST90016588 Kim UKB ever-smoker spirometric COPD
A.exact_smoking_subset_ld: No exact/subgroup-specific signed matrix obtained from legitimate public sources; controlled-access subset genotypes or an author-provided compatible release would be a separate route requiring appropriate access
A.relationship: Full-Pan-UKB-EUR external reference for a smoking-selected UKB analysis; participant overlap likely at project level but exact overlap not documented, and reference does not recreate the smoking subgroup
A.reference_ld_candidacy: A plausible ancestry/source-related external reference for diagnostics; not cleared for RSS solely by public availability or numerical PSD
A.sample_covariate_caveat: Kim logistic analysis and subset selection need not share Pan-UKB sample selection, dosage missingness or covariate projection; smoking-associated selection may alter covariance. Impact cannot be bounded from absent Kim AF/N/INFO fields alone.
unresolved_gates: Exact/subgroup-compatible LD absent, or separate scientific justification for external-reference approximation
Kim source AF/per-variant N/INFO absent and exact historical logistic/formatting lineage incomplete
Unresolved strong-variant identities and normalized collisions from TrackA audit
Actual locus allele/order/coverage, spectral/conditional diagnostics and interpretation
Investigator approval and full input freeze only after every applicable gate

diagnostics_can_establish: Exact source identity/allele sign mapping and matrix order for retained variants
Finite, correctly reconstructed signed entries; positive diagonals and explicit scaling
Numerical symmetry/range/PSD/rank/conditioning and whether z projects into numerical null space
Lead/other-strong-variant representation, boundary distances and stored-band availability
Descriptive z/LD conditional residuals and scalar null-covariance mismatch under declared diagnostic model
diagnostics_cannot_establish: Original sample membership, original job-code identity or exact historical release lineage
Equivalence of unweighted covariate-residual genotype correlation and SPA-calibrated mixed-model statistic covariance
Scientific validity of substituting nominal/effective N or using fullEUR LD for smoking selection
Absence of long-range correlation outside the stored10Mb band
Fine-mapping eligibility simply because numerical tests pass; multiple true signals can also produce residuals
provider_high_quality_policy: Not a blanket exclusion. Provider high_quality is gnomAD-genomes PASS plus multi-population AF concordance, distinct from source EUR trait low_confidence and INFO/MAC. Retain strong flagged variants in evidence/overlap ledgers and evaluate under frozen gates; do not redraw loci.
overlap_policy: A and C share UKB source participants and are not independent replication tracks; do not combine their evidence as independent. This audit does not create a meta-analysis.
